lane_description: Direct local-rule burden observed on Korean-market Korean-platform rows
why_separate: This is the cleanest direct burden lane and should not be mixed with institutional under-reach.

lane_description: Difference in Korean enforcement reach and filing visibility between domestic and foreign rows in Korea
why_separate: Reach asymmetry is conceptually distinct from ordinary domestic rule burden.

lane_description: Incidence of creator- and artist-protection costs in Korea
why_separate: Normative protection can still produce a positive Korean-platform burden score if domestic platforms bear more of the cost.

lane_description: Funding, cashflow, and recovery-pressure burden in Korean-market comparisons
why_separate: This lane is closest to observable financial burden.

lane_description: Switching, bundle leverage, and local-share erosion pressure in Korea
why_separate: This lane needs explicit guardrails because the legacy market proxy overcompresses different mechanisms.

lane_description: Difference between implied Korean-market tax liability and actually visible tax capture of foreign platforms
why_separate: Tax enforceability is important but is often single-firm and case-study driven.

lane_description: Non-core mechanism modules such as monitoring IT cost or data-combination opportunity cost
why_separate: Useful for enrichment but unsafe as core headline evidence.
